abilities.name: Silent Verdict
abilities.text: After Jacaelon wins a Political Conflict against a Character, the opposing Ruler loses 2 additional Standing.

abilities.name: Housebreaker
abilities.text: When Military damage dealt by Gaelor destroys an enemy Character during a Military Conflict, deal 2 damage to the opposing Ruler's Standing.

abilities.name: Dawn's Edge
abilities.text: Prevent the first 2 points of Military damage that would be dealt to Alester each turn.

abilities.name: The Mander's Pact
abilities.text: Choose another Character. It gains +2 Influence permanently. At the start of Renrose's Ruler's next turn, if that exact Character is still in play, draw 1 card.

abilities.name: As I Was Saying
abilities.text: Draw 1 card. If this ability successfully drew a card on Cordin's Ruler's previous turn, the card drawn by this ability this turn costs 1 less Command until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Veiled Sight
abilities.text: After Saera enters play, reveal the opposing Ruler's hand. Choose one card. Until the start of Saera's Ruler's next turn, that exact card costs 2 more Command to play.

abilities.name: Iron Wrath
abilities.text: After Baelenys enters play, deal 3 damage to another Unit. If that Unit is destroyed this way, Baelenys's Ruler gains 3 Standing.

abilities.name: The Price of Loyalty
abilities.text: If Weylar has survived 3 of the same Ruler’s turns in play, draw 2 cards and gain 2 additional Command this turn.

abilities.name: Hidden Claim
abilities.text: Visenor's Ruler draws 1 card. If Visenor's Ruler controls no other Targaryen Character, the card drawn this way costs 1 less Command until the end of that turn.

abilities.name: The People Have Suffered Enough
abilities.text: Restore 3 Standing.

abilities.name: The Argumentative One
abilities.text: The next Event the opposing Ruler plays costs 2 more Command.

abilities.name: Dangerous Name
abilities.text: While Rhaella is Ready, the first enemy Political Conflict against you each turn has -2 Influence.

abilities.name: Buried Secret
abilities.text: After Maela wins a Political Conflict against a Character, the opposing Ruler's next card costs 1 more Command.

abilities.name: Dark Sister's Legacy
abilities.text: Choose an enemy Character. It cannot initiate a Political Conflict during that Character's Ruler's next turn.

abilities.name: The Confession
abilities.text: Derrin's Ruler draws 2 cards. The opposing Ruler draws 1 card.

abilities.name: You Never Saw Me
abilities.text: After Visenya wins a Military Conflict against a Character, if this is her first deployment this game, she cannot be targeted by enemy Characters, Events, or abilities until the start of her Ruler's next turn.

abilities.name: Playing Her Own Game
abilities.text: At the end of her Ruler's 3rd turn with Visenya in play, if she is still in play, return her to her Ruler's hand. This ability can trigger only once per game.

abilities.name: Starfall's Shadow
abilities.text: While Lorenah is in play, other Characters ruled by her Ruler cannot be targeted by enemy Events.

abilities.name: Our Fleet Is Yours
abilities.text: Summon two 1/0/1 Velaryon Sailors ruled by Naella's Ruler. While Driftmark is the active Location, Velaryon Sailors have +1 Power.

abilities.name: The Gods Will Judge
abilities.text: Restore 3 Standing.

abilities.name: Dreams of Things to Come
abilities.text: Look at the top 3 cards of the opposing Ruler's deck. Vhaemys's Ruler may put one of them on the bottom of that deck. Return the others in the same order.

abilities.name: Innkeeper! Another!
abilities.text: Adjacent Characters have +1 Health while Saathos is in play.

abilities.name: A Baratheon Kneels When He Feels Safe
abilities.text: Steffon's Power and Influence cannot be reduced by enemy effects.

abilities.name: Knights of Oldtown

abilities.name: The Last Name Standing

abilities.name: Gracious in Defeat

abilities.text: The first time Baran takes Military damage each turn, if he survives that damage, he gains +2 Power until the end of the turn.

abilities.text: Ser Brannyn Vance cannot initiate a Military Conflict against a Targaryen Character. When defending against a Military Conflict initiated by a Targaryen Character, Ser Brannyn Vance deals no Military damage back.

abilities.name: Dragonstone's Quiet
abilities.text: While Dragonstone is the active Location, Units ruled by Malaenar's current Ruler have +1 Health.

abilities.name: She Organized the Whole Thing

abilities.name: Whereabouts Unknown

abilities.name: Death in His Own Bed
abilities.text: Choose a Stark or Targaryen Character ruled by Brandon's Ruler. It gains +1 Influence permanently.

abilities.name: Deal With the Money
abilities.text: The first Event or Location you play each turn costs 1 less Command.

abilities.name: Safe Passage
abilities.text: Choose another Character ruled by Martyn's Ruler. Enemy Characters cannot initiate Conflicts against it until the start of Martyn's Ruler's next turn.

abilities.name: Proud of His Name
abilities.text: Whenever you deploy Visenor Targaryen, another Tyrell Character, or a Hightower Character, Leo gains +1 Influence permanently.

abilities.name: Do Not Forget It, My Lady
abilities.text: The first time another Character ruled by Almar's Ruler would receive a negative stat modifier each turn, prevent that modifier.

abilities.name: They Are Utterly Fucked
abilities.text: Look at the top 3 cards of Edmyn's Ruler's deck. Put one into that Ruler's hand and put the rest on the bottom of that deck in any order.

abilities.name: Unintended

abilities.text: The first time Perric would take damage from an Event each turn, prevent 2 of that damage.

abilities.name: A Drunken Mistake

abilities.name: Bond — Jacaelon

abilities.name: Bond — Saera

abilities.name: Bond — Baelenys
abilities.text: If Maelwing's Ruler controls Baelenys Targaryen, Maelwing costs 2 less to play.

abilities.text: Choose one Character ruled by you and one enemy Character. They immediately deal Military damage equal to their Power to each other simultaneously.

abilities.name: Oldtown Massacre
abilities.text: Deal 2 damage to every Character on the board. Deal 2 damage to both Rulers' Standing.

abilities.name: The Brothers' Tilt
abilities.text: Choose a Character. It gains +1 Power for each other Character in play with lower Power than it, up to +3. Then Exhaust it.

abilities.name: A Moment of Sight

abilities.name: Read the Crowd

abilities.name: Perfect Timing

abilities.name: Quiet Protection

abilities.name: Promising Blade

abilities.name: Before Dawn

abilities.name: Guarded Questions

abilities.name: Golden Rose Brooch
